testcase.name: Scenario: Change ribbon context while editing an existing sketch: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:537:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change ribbon context while editing an existing sketch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part containing an existing extrusion and sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon is minimized to tabs with Tools selected ✔ When the user expands the extrusion in the model browser ✔ And the user double-clicks its sketch ✔ Then the Sketch tab is selected while the ribbon remains minimized to tabs ✔ When the user selects the Tools tab ✔ Then temporary Tools command groups appear beneath the tabs ✔ And Finish is available in an Exit group ✔ When the user selects Finish ✔ Then sketch editing ends and the part model is displayed ✔ And the ribbon remains minimized to tabs with Tools selected
